purpose: Final hero-detail integrity gate and page-ready output contract.

temporaryNameOverrides.reason: Canonical Korean-name source correction is pending; downstream display only.

presentationRules: Base mode is shown first; SP mode is shown only when SP data exists.
Exclusive equipment and covenant sections remain present and may display 미출시 instead of being omitted.
Skin ordering is release order and must preserve acquisition metadata when available.
Skills are ordered by acquisition group when the source relation is available: tier1, tier2, SP, awakening.
Do not emit subjective ratings or recommended gear.

PASS: heroId is unique and exists in the canonical hero master
normal Job/Skill references contain no unresolved hard relation errors
when SP exists, SP record resolves to the same canonical heroId and all referenced SP missions exist
REVIEW: display/enrichment fields such as CV, factions, origin, artwork, skins, bonds, exclusive equipment, covenant, soldiers or stat labels are not connected yet
skill/job Korean display names are pending while IDs and source relations are valid
Hero-SP MissionType 73 material bundle direct target is not yet verified
FAIL: normal normalized record is missing after stage 3-2 is declared ready
Job/Skill/Mission reference points to a missing record
SP record belongs to an unknown hero
one hero receives multiple incompatible SP ownership records

currentBlockers: Stage 3-2 is source-blocked by broken JobInfo/JobConnectionInfo/JobLevelInfo/SkillInfo exports.
Stage 3-3 is source-blocked by broken SPHeroInfo/MissionExtSPHeroInfo/MissionInfo and detail-source exports.
Final PASS page data must not be emitted until the upstream normalized inputs exist.
completionRule: Run the finalizer only after stage 3-2 and stage 3-3 normalized inputs are available. The finalizer may always emit validation summary files, but pageData may contain only PASS records. REVIEW and FAIL records remain separated from public page output.
notes: Stage 3-4 is intentionally able to report SOURCE_BLOCKED without fabricating missing upstream data.
heroId is the only canonical join key; Korean names are display values only.
The page contract follows the project design: hero art/skin header, identity metadata, normal/SP mode, core information, stats, jobs/skills or SP missions.
Missing optional presentation data is REVIEW rather than FAIL so later asset/CV/faction work can be attached without redesigning the hero data core.
